Consider the following PR description:
Collision counter decrements instead of increments

When hash collisions occur in the cache, the collision statistics are being decremented instead of incremented. This results in negative collision counts which doesn't make sense for a counter that should only go up.

#### Steps to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/allegro/bigcache/v3"
    "time"
)

func main() {
    cache, _ := bigcache.NewBigCache(bigcache.DefaultConfig(10 * time.Minute))
    
    // Force a collision by using keys that hash to the same value
    cache.Set("a", []byte("value1"))
    cache.Set("b", []byte("value2")) // This will cause a collision
    
    stats := cache.Stats()
    fmt.Printf("Collisions: %d\n", stats.Collisions)
    // Expected: positive number (1 or more)
    // Actual: negative number (-1)
}
```

The collision counter shows negative values when it should be counting upwards from zero.
</pr_description>
